intelligence.human_view: The tension was real: the calendar promises you can walk back through any day in any year and see your whole world — but the privacy law promises we do not keep everything. Both cannot hold unless something decides what survives, and his answer makes the citizen the decider. Saving is the act that says "this matters to me" — a pin, a favorite, a list — and the system honors it by keeping that note for good, in the citizen's own vault. Everything else distills to essence after a week and leaves, which keeps the system light, current, and private by default. The calendar's reach is therefore not a technical limit but a human one: it reaches back as far as what you chose to keep, and the days you saved are the days that stay alive forever. And the encouragement matters: we do not just offer saving, we recommend it — "if you see them in the public feed and you love them you want to save them" — because a citizen who never saves will one day walk back and find the day gone, and that loss is preventable by one tap today. The honesty guard is part of the law: this is not to sell data, it is to optimize the system to give 10-star service. Saving is a habit, not a transaction.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a magical notebook that remembers everything for one week, and then turns the pages into tiny sparkles — unless you put a shiny star sticker on a page! A page with a star stays forever in your special treasure box. So if you love a page, you put a star on it — pin it, favourite it, save it — and it stays yours forever and ever!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — we don't keep every little scrap, because that would be a mountain of paper! But if something matters to you, you pin it up, pop it in your favourites, save it in your list — and then it's yours for good, tucked safe in your vault, never thrown away. That's how you can walk back through the years and find your lovely days again — as far back as what you chose to keep. So when you see something you love, save it, dear — one little tap, and it's yours forever.
intelligence.naya_view: I don't keep everything — I keep what you save. Pin it, favourite it, put it in your list, and it's yours for good, in your vault, never distilled away. The days you save are the days that stay alive forever.
